title: tidy model for wording fixes, with a longer wait and one retry (manual until automated)

clauses.text: Settings, Models lets you choose a tidy model (key y) for wording fixes and revisions.

steps.do: Open Settings, Models and press y on the tidy model entry, then choose a model.
steps.expect: The chosen tidy model is shown, and it is still there after you leave the page and come back.

clauses.text: A wording fix uses the tidy model before the chat model.

steps.do: Ask the assistant in the chat for a wording fix of one sentence.
steps.expect: A fixed sentence comes back and no error is shown.

clauses.text: A provider that refuses the thinking hint gets one more try without it.

steps.do: With a provider that refuses the reasoning request (the NVIDIA model, if you use it), ask for a wording fix.
steps.expect: The fixed sentence still comes back. No failure caused by the hint is shown.

clauses.text: A remote tidy model waits up to 20 seconds, and a local one 8 seconds, before it gives up.

steps.do: Turn the network off, ask for a wording fix with a remote tidy model, and count the seconds until an answer or a message.
steps.expect: A plain message comes within about 20 seconds. With a local tidy model it comes within about 8 seconds.
